name: Pagination
description: Semantic pagination markup using buttonVariants. Presentational only — the page state and routing are yours.
intent: Move through a result set that is too large to show at once.

props.name: className
props.hint: Merged with the component classes via cn(). Use for layout only — never to override a variant that already exists.

requiredAttributes: aria-label="pagination" on the nav — set by the component
notes: Renders anchors. For client-side routing, use asChild with your router link.
Previous and Next are not disabled at the boundaries automatically. Handle that yourself or they lead nowhere.
Announce the page change in a live region — the content updates silently otherwise.

usage: When the total count is known and useful
When users need to return to a specific page
doNotUse: Feeds where infinite scroll suits the content better
When the total is unknown — use a simpler next-and-previous pair

agentRules: Disable previous and next at the boundaries yourself.
Set isActive on the current page.
Announce page changes in a live region.
